traits.name: Melee Strike
traits.text: ⬻ (finesse); Damage 1d6+2 (1d6+2) piercing plus giant spider venom

traits.name: Descend on a Web
traits.text: ⬻ (move); The giant spider moves straight down up to 40 feet, suspended by a web line. It can hang from the web or drop off. The distance it Descends on a Web doesn't count for falling damage. A creature can Strike the web, which has AC 20 and 8 HP. If the web is reduced to 0 HP, the spider falls.

traits.name: Giant Spider Venom
traits.text: (poison); A target damaged by the spider's fangs must succeed at a DC 16 Fortitude save or take 1d12 (1d12) poison damage and gain the flat-footed condition for 1 round.

traits.name: Web Trap
traits.text: A creature hit by the giant spider's web Strike gets stuck to the nearest surface. It can't move until it successfully Escapes (DC 17)
